'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Matt Thornton DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' We are the Knights who say Ni Chuba Na!
* '''Username:''' BrenDerlin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
